'''Admiral Thrawn Revolution It's Grand Climax At Hand''' is a strategy article published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] under the handle Admiral Thrawn, titled ''Revolution...It's Grand Climax At Hand!''. The page includes a sample [[Revolution]] list.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Revolutionclimax.htm Revolution...It's Grand Climax At Hand!], The Outer Rim (Admiral Thrawn). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030141621/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Revolutionclimax.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Article ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Revolution...It's Grand
Climax At Hand!


If the Rebels have ever embraced
the Dark Side of the Force It would be the card..REVOLUTION!! Not only does
it starve your opponent of force, but it prevents strategy for the Dark Side
from coming about. Well, don't feel embarrassed for using a good tourney worth
deck and using it to win a few tournaments. When there is a great deck to play,
use it. That is the name of the Tourney Environment game! Make sure your

deck has 6-8 2/0 locations, lots of mains and toys, 6-8 revolutions and you
are ready to kick the imperials of or out of your system! Remember to battle
the Dark Side where ever they appear!


Now here is a versatile deck, and it can defeat just about all types of dark
decks out there. This deck can be defeated though! It takes quite a bit of manipulation
on the Dark Side and preparation to make itself undefeatable to Revolution.
For instance there are cards like Sense/Alter, Battle Order, Monnok, Evader,
Undercover, and Imperial Decree!!! The Revolver deck is back, greater than ever.
Will you be able to prevent the opponent from gaining the upperhand on you?


Here is a basic Revolution deck.....You Make it better!!!
